positive.en: three mutually exclusive branches: (1) no production ICS conversion profile exists in this generation, so ICS returns `unsupported_profile` and creates no conversion author effect or OriginBinding; (2) for an already-supported ordinary-file profile with no D3 binding semantics, each separately explicit import is fresh, while retry/recovery of the same canonical request replays the original request/result and never creates a substitute request to escape uncertainty; (3) when D3 SourceBinding/ForeignIdentityKey semantics apply, use the original D3 state/Adopt protocol: from never_bound, explicit `initial_import` or explicit Adopt may create one fresh Node and the sole OriginBinding in the same authoritative decision; exact retry reuses that decision. active_live is not fresh and is never auto-upserted, active_non_live rejects, retired becomes fresh only through a new explicit Adopt, conflict rejects, and a binding miss never auto-promotes to import/adopt
